goal: Break up a monolithic peer-to-peer message dispatcher into individual message handlers
Makes code navigation, local reasoning, and reviewing changes easier for maintainers
reviewability: Needs rebase due to conflicts with master
Reviewing the logic now is worthwhile because the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Strong support for improving peer-to-peer code navigation and encapsulation (stickies-v, maflcko)
Verified as a move-only refactor through diffing and test coverage (pseudoramdom, l0rinc)
Verified rebase and suggested additional handler extractions that were adopted (pablomartin4btc)
Conceded objection: separate helpers add caller ambiguity compared to a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal refactoring that improves code navigation and modularity
It alters no protocol behavior, performance, or denial-of-service defenses
